given: A single SKU has stock filed at two different locations
when: The team member opens the home stock-by-location table
then: That SKU appears as two distinct rows, one per location, each showing its own location and its own quantity
architectural_notes: Behavior test seeds one SKU at two locations on the paired branch, reads via app/routes -> StockService -> StockRepository, and asserts two distinct rendered rows, so E2E. Exercises the per-(sku, location) grain (PI1) so a SKU spanning locations is never collapsed into a single row.

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts each filed record renders as a row; AC3 asserts the per-location grain specifically, that one SKU at two locations yields two distinct rows. A build could pass AC1 by listing rows yet still collapse a multi-location SKU into one row, failing AC3 while AC1 stays green.
